name: gu_depth_range
comment: Depth range on the current GU context; set to 0xFFF0..0x10 at 0x0880ACC4.

name: gu_depth_offset
comment: Depth offset on the current GU context; effect_sprite_draw_frame passes an effect's instance +0x22 below 0x199A.

name: gu_tex_func
comment: sceGuTexFunc(tfx, tcc) with the context's colour doubling flag (+0xE4).

name: gu_depth_func
comment: ZTST (0xDE): 1 always, 7 greater-or-equal.

name: gu_depth_mask
comment: ZMSK (0xE7): 1 disables depth writes.

name: gu_blend_func
comment: sceGuBlendFunc(op, src, dst, srcfix, dstfix).

name: gu_set_status_context
comment: sceGuSetStatus: state 0 ATE, 1 ZTE, 3 STE, 4 ABE, 5 BCE, 6 DTE, 7 FGE, 9 TME; 0x15 colour doubling (context +0xE4, TFUNC 0xC9).

name: gu_depth_range_context
comment: sceGuDepthRange(near, far) on a context: +0xD8/+0xDC, viewport Z from their midpoint plus the depth offset.

name: gu_depth_offset_context
comment: sceGuDepthOffset: stores the offset at context +0xE0 and re-emits viewport Z scale/position (0x44/0x47) and NEARZ/FARZ (0xD6/0xD7) with the depth range at +0xD8/+0xDC.

name: light_list_insert
comment: Inserts a light by priority unless already linked (+0xA0), so a repeated lighting record adds no light.

name: effect_sprite_bind
comment: Binds an effect instance: colour 0xFFFFFF, opacity 1, frame table, depth offset at +0x22 from the effect, test state 0x50000 then the blend's.

name: effect_sprite_set_blend
comment: Instance +0x40 = blend table[mode]; +0x48 test state 0x100B for mode 0, else 0x1001 with +0x4C bit 0x20.

name: effect_sprite_draw_frame
comment: Draws one frame of an effect as a camera-facing sprite at a point with the effect's alpha, culled by distance.

name: composition_set_model_test
comment: Per composition child: selector 1 sets TEST low bits 0x1001 (value 0) or 0x100B; 0 sets bit 16; 2 sets bits 14..15.

name: composition_draw
comment: Draws a composition player's models and effects at their composed transforms.

name: model_select_blend
comment: Adds for a model blend 0x48 and subtracts for 0x42 (table 0x08AF1C08: 0x44,0x48,0x42,0x09,0x54); every other entry blends as plain alpha.

name: animation_set_fog_mode
comment: Sets each animated object's fog mode (+0xA8 bits 3..4) and effect flag (+0xDE bit 5); 0x5AA mist passes 1.

name: random_next
comment: Mersenne twister (MT19937) next 32-bit output.

name: random_signed_scaled
comment: scale x signed Mersenne-twister output / 2^31, in -scale..scale.

name: music_request
comment: Requests music row param_1 with its loop and fade arguments.

name: stage_scene_construct
comment: Walks a scene's records by category (type bits 8..15) to UN2's handlers; publishes the scene at battle context +0x3D.

name: stage_parse_fog
comment: Category 1: tokens 0..2 colour, 3 near, 4 far, 5 far percentage.

name: stage_parse_lighting
comment: Category 13: light animation, token 5 light count; token 10 R,G,B (not "0") sets the render environment colour, else the light's.

name: stage_parse_animation_props
comment: Category 5: constructs a subtype per record, including UNH2's 0x5A9 lantern lights, 0x5AA mist and 0x5AB translucent layers.

name: stage_lantern_lights_construct
comment: 0x5A9 constructor: clears the effect, positions, count and opacities.

name: stage_lantern_lights_parse
comment: 0x5A9: token 5 count, token 3 node and its %s_%d siblings, token 6 effect; one effect sprite drawn at each node.

name: stage_lantern_lights_update
comment: 0x5A9: unless stage effects are restricted (0x08898EA4(2)), each opacity walks by random_signed_scaled(0.05) within 0.2..0.5.

name: stage_lantern_lights_draw
comment: 0x5A9: draws frame 0 of the effect at each node at its opacity in draw environment 3.

name: stage_translucent_construct
comment: 0x5AB constructor: clears the composition player.

name: stage_translucent_parse
comment: 0x5AB: token 10 composition in a player, its models' TEST set by composition_set_model_test(1, 0) to 0x1001, no depth writes.

name: stage_translucent_draw
comment: 0x5AB: composition_draw of its player; its update (0x088C49E8) is empty.

name: camera_bind_stage_record
comment: Saves the previous stage camera record (+0x180) and binds stage_camera_records_by_scene[scene] at +0x17C.

name: camera_stage_track
comment: Lowers the desired elevation by record +0x4C when sections differ and by +0x50 when either is nonzero, as UN2's 0x001ED960.

name: stage_navigation_initialize
comment: Collects line extents, then copies the scene's routes until source 0xFF or 64 rows, so a zero-row end is copied with the following rows.

name: audio_play_mode_music
comment: Case 5: the scene's stage_music_tracks entry unless the override at 0x08BD06F4 is set.

name: model_blend_alpha_table
comment: PS2 ALPHA values kept as blend identifiers: 0x44, 0x48, 0x42, 0x09, 0x54.

name: music_rows
comment: 12-byte rows: disc path, loop flag, volume; stage00..10, then the other tracks.

name: stage_effect_intensity
comment: A byte per scene 0..19; UN2's 18 then 0xFF, 0xFF.

name: stage_render_coefficients
comment: Two floats per scene 0..19; UN2's 18 then (0.32, 0.3) and (0.45, 0.3).

name: stage_scene_tables
comment: 20 pointers (scenes 0..19: UN2's 18, then s8a Outside and s8b Inside the Mugenjo) to UN2-layout 32-byte scene records.

name: stage_camera_records_by_scene
comment: 20 pointers to 22-float camera records: UN2's fields 0..21.

name: stage_navigation_authored_routes
comment: 20 pointers to UN2-layout route rows; lists end with a zero row, scenes 18 and 19 reuse scenes 16's and 17's.

name: stage_music_tracks
comment: A word per scene: the music_rows track (stageNN.at3), 0x0F where the disc has no archive.
